title: In situ generated CF3CHN2 with 3-ylideneoxindoles to access CF3-containing pyrazolo[1,5-c]quinazolines derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36410-36415
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06651K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ming-Cheng Hu, Hai-Tao Zhou, Yu-Chen Fang, Li-Ren Zhang, Bao-Dong Cui, Yong-Zheng Chen, Mei Bai
A protocol involving a DBU-promoted [3 + 2] cycloaddition/1,3-H shift/rearrangement/dehydrogenation cascade was developed, giving a series of CF3-containing pyrazole[1,5-c]quinazolines in 35–86% yields.
